intent: Metric 3 semantic models: the daily wait and its milestones

edits.new_content:
version: 2
semantic_models:
- name: fct_world_output_daily
  description: 'Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6: world real output on each
    UTC day from GTA V''s release (2013-09-17) to the day before GTA 6''s (2026-11-18), and the running
    total since GTA V. One row per day. Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative
    output across days.'
  model: ref('fct_world_output_daily')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: output_day
  entities:
  - name: world_output_day
    type: primary
    expr: output_day
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  dimensions:
  - name: output_day
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: UTC day of the wait.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: data_year
    type: categorical
    description: Calendar year of the day.
  - name: is_estimate
    type: categorical
    description: True when the day's year is carried by IMF growth (2026).
  measures:
  - name: daily_output
    agg: sum
    expr: daily_output
    description: World real output made on the day, constant 2015 US$ (the year spread evenly).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: currency:USD
          additivity: additive
          null_rule: NULL when the year's output is unavailable.
  - name: cumulative_output
    agg: max
    expr: cumulative_output
    description: Running total of world real output since GTA V's release, through the day. Never sum
      it across days.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: output_day
      window_choice: max
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: currency:USD
          additivity: semi_additive
          null_rule: NULL from the first unavailable day on.
- name: fct_wait_milestones
  description: 'Metric 3: the milestones of the wait between GTA V and GTA 6 (editorial picks, one public
    source each), each with the world real output made since GTA V by the day before it. One row per milestone.
    Constant 2015 US$; 2026 is an IMF-based estimate; never add cumulative output across days.'
  model: ref('fct_wait_milestones')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: event_date
  entities:
  - name: milestone
    type: primary
    expr: milestone_id
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  dimensions:
  - name: event_date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: UTC day of the event.
  - name: milestone_id
    type: categorical
    description: Slug.
  - name: title
    type: categorical
    description: What happened.
  - name: chart_label
    type: categorical
    description: Short label for the chart.
  - name: category
    type: categorical
    description: Theme; rockstar marks the Rockstar nods.
  - name: tier
    type: categorical
    description: anchor, hero (on the chart) or long (site table only).
  - name: date_precision
    type: categorical
    description: day, or month.
  - name: source_url
    type: categorical
    description: One public source for the date.
  measures:
  - name: output_by_then
    agg: max
    expr: output_by_then
    description: World real output made from GTA V's release through the day before the event, constant
      2015 US$.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: currency:USD
          additivity: semi_additive
          null_rule: NULL outside the wait.
  - name: share_of_wait_output
    agg: max
    expr: share_of_wait_output
    description: output_by_then over the whole wait's output (0 to 1).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: fraction
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: days_to_gta_6
    agg: max
    expr: days_to_gta_6
    description: Days from the event to GTA 6's release day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: days
          additivity: non_additive
